$comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to config/db-queries.json (git-ignored) and replace every remaining PENDING_… placeholder. A query that still contains PENDING_ is treated as not configured and never runs.
Filled from tech doc v3 §24 (PostgreSQL): user_pii_field_value(user_id, field_name, ciphertext, nonce, auth_tag, key_version, lookup_token). Confirm with Dev that this schema is what QA runs (Q-30).

Still pending: the tech doc's table has NO tenant column (Q-37), so PENDING_TENANT_COL stays until Dev says how tenants are stored. Temporary phones and encryption keys are not in the tech doc (Q-30).

findAuditEventsByRequestId is null: per tech doc §39 the audit trail lives in MongoDB (collection audit_trails, fields action + request_id), not in SQL. PII-DB-007 needs read-only MongoDB access, which the framework does not support yet (Q-35).

Rules: read-only SELECT/WITH only; one statement; $1.. placeholders for postgres; 'params' lists named parameters in placeholder order; each query MUST return the column aliases in docs/database-setup.md.

findPiiRecords.sql: SELECT PENDING_TENANT_COL AS tenant_id, user_id AS user_id, field_name AS field, ciphertext AS encrypted_value, key_version AS key_version FROM user_pii_field_value WHERE PENDING_TENANT_COL = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND field_name = $3

findTransientPhone.sql: SELECT PENDING_TENANT_COL AS tenant_id, PENDING_CALLER_COL AS caller_id, PENDING_CIPHERTEXT_COL AS encrypted_value, PENDING_EXPIRES_COL AS expires_at, (PENDING_CONSUMED_COL IS NOT NULL) AS is_consumed FROM PENDING_TRANSIENT_TABLE WHERE PENDING_ID_COL = $1

findFreeTextKey.sql: SELECT PENDING_TENANT_COL AS tenant_id, PENDING_CALLER_COL AS caller_id, PENDING_STATUS_COL AS status, PENDING_REVOKED_AT_COL AS revoked_at, PENDING_WRAPPED_KEY_COL AS encrypted_key_material FROM PENDING_FREE_TEXT_KEY_TABLE WHERE PENDING_ID_COL = $1
